title: Grateful Dead Live at Star Theatre on 1970-03-08
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an intimate show highlighted by a stellar Black Peter and Lovelight, but the surprise guest ruins the final three songs.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crisp SBD transfer that showcases the band at its hot, acoustic best – Black Peter shines and Lovelight sizzles. Unfortunately, an unknown singer (likely Elvin Bishop) takes over the last three numbers, dragging down the finale for many listeners. Overall the performance and sound quality are strong enough to recommend despite the ending.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording is praised as excellent while the show receives mixed feedback – strong early set but a poorly received guest on the closing songs, yielding a solid mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear SBD capture; reviewers repeatedly note great sound and a good transfer with no major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Intimate acoustic set early in a small venue, followed by an unexpected guest that dominates the final three songs, leaving the overall show strong but the ending disappointing.
